# UltraPixel

> UltraPixel is a manufacturer of premium and technical self-adhesive labels based in Trieste, Italy, serving brands across Europe.

UltraPixel Srl (VAT IT01240410322) was founded in 2013. It designs, prints and finishes self-adhesive labels in Trieste, Italy, for brands, wineries, manufacturers, agents and distributors in Italy and across Europe.

## Company facts

- UltraPixel Srl: Via J. Ressel 3, 34018 San Dorligo della Valle (TS), Italy
- UltraPixel France: 11 Rue Pouteau, 69001 Lyon, France
- Email: info@ultrapixel.it
- Phone: +39 040 817222
- Website languages: Italiano, English, Français, Deutsch

## Sectors

- [Wine & Spirits labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/wine-spirits/) / [Wine & Spirits labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/wine-spirits/): Premium papers, foil, embossing and tactile effects, with materials selected for ice buckets and complex finishing in register.
- [Food labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/food-labels/) / [Food labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/food-labels/): Labels for industrial production and automatic application, with materials and adhesives selected for cold, humidity and contact with oils.
- [Cosmetics & Nutraceuticals labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/cosmetics-nutraceuticals/) / [Cosmetics & Nutraceuticals labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/cosmetics-nutraceuticals/): Premium decoration on transparent and special materials, with opaque whites, tactile effects and small batches.
- [Pharma labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/pharma-labels/) / [Pharma labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/pharma-labels/): Labels printed for precision and readability, with solutions for variable data, traceability and consistency between runs.
- [Industrial & Chemical labels](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/industrial-chemical/) / [Industrial & Chemical labels (English)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/industrial-chemical/): Technical materials and adhesives selected for difficult surfaces and demanding conditions, with variable data, QR codes and traceability.

## Guides for label buyers

- [Come scegliere un fornitore di etichette: la checklist per brand e buyer](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-label-supplier/) / [How to choose a label supplier in Europe: a checklist for brands and buyers](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/how-to-choose-a-label-supplier/): A practical checklist for brand owners and procurement teams choosing a self-adhesive label supplier in Europe: materials, finishes, colour control, versions, samples and red flags.
- [Come chiedere un preventivo per etichette: la checklist per avere un prezzo esatto](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-quote-specification-checklist/) / [How to request a label quote: the specification checklist that gets you an exact price](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-quote-specification-checklist/): The information a label printer needs for an exact quote: size and shape, quantities and versions, material, container and conditions, finishes, roll data for the applicator, variable data and artwork.
- [Lamina a caldo, serigrafia, rilievo o vernice tattile: quale nobilitazione per quale effetto](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/premium-label-finishes-compared/) / [Hot foil, screen printing, embossing or tactile varnish: which premium label finish for which effect](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/premium-label-finishes-compared/): Which premium label finish for which effect: hot foil, screen printing, embossing, debossing, tactile varnish, microtextures and die-cutting compared, with what each is best for and what to watch.
- [Etichette per secchiello e bottiglie refrigerate: perché cedono e come specificarle](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/ice-bucket-labels/) / [Labels for ice buckets and chilled bottles: why they fail and how to specify them](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/ice-bucket-labels/): Why wine and spirits labels wrinkle, peel or lose their finish in ice buckets and fridges, and how to specify facestock, adhesive and protection so they survive. Includes a simple test protocol.
- [PPWR ed etichette: cosa cambia con il Regolamento UE sugli imballaggi per le etichette adesive (2026–2030)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/ppwr-and-labels/) / [PPWR and labels: what the EU Packaging Regulation means for self-adhesive labels (2026–2030)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/ppwr-and-labels/): What Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR) means for labels: key dates from August 2026 to 2030, harmonised sorting labels, compostable fruit stickers, recyclability, and what brand owners should ask their label printer.
- [Etichette del vino UE: ingredienti, valori nutrizionali e QR code dell'e-label (Regolamento (UE) 2021/2117)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/eu-wine-label-e-label-qr-code/) / [EU wine labels: ingredients, nutrition and the e-label QR code (Regulation (EU) 2021/2117)](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/eu-wine-label-e-label-qr-code/): What EU wine labelling rules (Regulation (EU) 2021/2117) require on the physical label and what can go in an e-label via QR code, and how to print a QR code that scans on textured paper and foil.
- [Perché il rotolo di etichette si rompe o si inceppa in linea, e come risolvere](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-roll-breaks-on-labelling-line/) / [Why label rolls break or jam on the labelling line, and how to fix it](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-roll-breaks-on-labelling-line/): Liner breaks, labels not dispensing, jams and missed labels on bottling and filling lines: the most common causes on the roll and on the machine, how to diagnose them and what to specify to the label supplier.
- [Come sviluppare una nuova etichetta: i passaggi dal brief alla prima produzione](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/how-to-develop-a-new-label/) / [How to develop a new product label: the steps from brief to first production](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/how-to-develop-a-new-label/): The steps to develop a new self-adhesive label without surprises: brief, container and conditions, regulatory content, die line, material, artwork, proofs, prototypes, line trial, master sample and production.
- [Etichette che fanno grinze, si sollevano o fanno bolle: cause e rimedi](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-wrinkles-flagging-bubbles/) / [Labels wrinkling, flagging or bubbling: causes and fixes](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-wrinkles-flagging-bubbles/): Why labels wrinkle on tapered bottles, lift at the edges on small diameters, or show bubbles and blisters on plastic containers, and what to change in material, adhesive, shape and application.
- [Come mantenere costante il colore delle etichette tra riordini, fornitori e stabilimenti](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-colour-consistency/) / [How to keep label colour consistent across reorders, suppliers and sites](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-colour-consistency/): How brand owners and buyers specify label colour so reorders, ranges and different suppliers match: colour references, spectral measurement, ΔE tolerances, measurement conditions, master samples and lighting.
- [Gara per le etichette in un gruppo multi-stabilimento: dalla RFQ al contratto](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-tender-for-multi-site-groups/) / [Running a label tender for a multi-site group: from RFQ to contract](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-tender-for-multi-site-groups/): A procurement guide for large groups sourcing self-adhesive labels across brands and plants: tender scope, specification pack, supplier qualification and line trials, quality agreement, KPIs, pricing structure, inventory models and dual sourcing.
- [Come ridurre i costi delle etichette senza perdere qualità: 9 leve per i buyer](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/reduce-label-costs/) / [How to reduce label costs without losing quality: 9 levers for buyers](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/reduce-label-costs/): Nine practical ways to lower the total cost of self-adhesive labels: harmonise sizes and materials, combine versions, right-size quantities, reduce obsolete stock, optimise rolls, plan artwork changes, use finishes where they matter and choose the right process.
- [Come conservare i rotoli di etichette perché girino bene in linea](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/how-to-store-label-rolls/) / [How to store label rolls so they run well on the line](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/how-to-store-label-rolls/): How to store self-adhesive label rolls so they run well on the line: temperature and humidity, how to stack rolls, first-in first-out, adhesive shelf life and acclimatising rolls before use.
- [Stampa etichette digitale o flexo: quale processo per quale tiratura](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/digital-vs-flexo-label-printing/) / [Digital vs flexo label printing: which process for which run](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/digital-vs-flexo-label-printing/): Digital and flexographic label printing compared for buyers: run length, number of versions, variable data, set-up, colour, finishes and lead time, with a decision table.
- [Quali certificazioni deve avere un fornitore di etichette? Guida per i buyer](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/label-supplier-certifications/) / [Which certifications should a label supplier have? A guide for buyers](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/label-supplier-certifications/): A buyer's guide to label supplier certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, FSC and PEFC chain of custody, BRCGS Packaging Materials, GMP for food contact materials and ISO 15378 for pharma, what each covers and how to verify it.
- [Dimensione minima dei caratteri sulle etichette alimentari UE: la regola della x da 1,2 e 0,9 mm](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/blog/eu-food-label-minimum-font-size/) / [Minimum font size on EU food labels: the 1.2 mm and 0.9 mm x-height rule](https://ultrapixel-homepage.onrender.com/en/blog/eu-food-label-minimum-font-size/): What Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 requires on food labels: 1.2 mm x-height, 0.9 mm on small packs, same field of vision, allergen emphasis, packs under 10 cm², languages, and how to fit everything on the label.
